scope: Local role/query readiness, explicit physical query-reader limits and fixed-size actual host resource usage, with retained-history and shared durable shutdown regressions. This does not complete MR-13.
environment: macOS actual public native Rust Node/SDK/SQLite/LTX/Raft Engine/TLS, filesystem state and authenticated local management. Three-voter and three-voter-plus-initial-learner fixtures; explicit single-voter development topology for held-reader and retained-state drills. Conditional in-memory archive and local development bucket, no cellar_internal_tests.

commands.name: inventory
argv: import json,pathlib,re; p=pathlib.Path('plans/multi-raft'); s=(p/'evidence/MR-13-readiness-pins-list.log').read_text(); n=set(re.findall(r'^(\S+): test$',s,re.M)); ts=json.loads((p/'tasks.json').read_text())['tasks']; assert all({c['name'] for c in t['test_cases']}<=n for t in ts if t['id']<'MR-13'); req={c['name'] for t in ts if t['id']=='MR-13' for c in t['test_cases']}; missing=req-n; assert missing=={'disaster_old_quorum_fenced','metrics_group_cardinality'}; assert len(req&n)==17; assert len([x for x in n if x.startswith('raft::host::readiness::tests::')])==3; assert 'native_readiness_reports_voters_learners_and_empty_image' in n and 'native_readiness_distinguishes_historical_and_recent_source' in n; print('All MR01-12 requirements, 17 MR13 native operations cases, three new readiness units and two native readiness drills listed. MR13 remains IN_PROGRESS; missing original cases:',sorted(missing))

source_freeze.includes: Every tracked Rust source and Cargo manifest/lock plus the recovery example smoke script; hashes match both immutable Git source and checkout.

observations: Role is tied to sampled term and exact cached configuration revision. Joint outgoing voters stay voters until leave; next learners cannot become leaders merely from a role hint.

Query readiness requires locally registered callbacks and coherent runtime/durable/published image positions. Empty images and voters without query callbacks refuse local query readiness. Historical and RecentSource eligibility remain distinct.

Disconnected historical queries preserve their committed value after freshness expiry; RecentSource and strong queries cannot use that observation to bypass the actual policy. A learner obtains a fresh ReadIndex for its strong read.
The source-deadline helper used by actual query admission is also used by readiness. Missing, future, exact-expiry and overflowing observations refuse freshness.

The node-wide SDK query-reader permit is owned by the blocking SQL stack until its callback and immutable database exit. Cancelling its async waiter retains actual usage 1 and cannot admit another query callback at limit 1.

Two independent SQL owners demonstrate typed Overloaded query refusal while control status and actual command/consensus/apply continue. After physical release, an exact minimum-version read returns 9.
Node-first shutdown remains pending with the cancelled physical reader held and actual usage 1. Releasing the callback permits the joined close result and actual usage 0.

resource_usage reads actual business/output, reserved control, archive-capture and query-reader budgets/capacities without I/O, callbacks or group enumeration; independent atomic loads are not a transactional snapshot. Retained external request/output owners are not replaced with artificial zeros.
remaining_features: Aggregate fixed-cardinality management/metrics export, actual SQL queues, transport banks/directions, retained images, apply/archive lag, controller resources and complete bounded role sampling
Production Raft CLI configuration/startup and remaining management surfaces
Safe bounded receipt maintenance preserving retry windows, client floors and latest receiver receipts
Verifiably fenced new-history disaster recovery and exact per-cell recovery points
Resolve the prior leadership-transfer refusal and the newly retained concurrent fallback refusal before complete operating qualification
All MR-14 through MR-17 workload, release/soak, physical-scale and federation gates
limitations: One pinned serial regression matrix only. The 847 passing (target,name) cases are unique and are not pooled from earlier source revisions or diagnostic replays. Nine ignored child entry points are excluded and run through their owning parents. Four SDK capability compile-fail doctests and two retained-root example processes are reported separately. Readiness is a capture-time local hint and neither reserves capacity nor proves current quorum; every strong query still needs a fresh barrier. Query-pin usage counts physical SDK callback-reader reservations, not every GenerationPin clone, image writer, archive, seed, checkpoint or effect reader. Existing image and other admission bounds remain separate. Fixed-size SDK resource usage is not yet a Prometheus/management metrics exporter or complete resource/health view. Production Raft CLI bootstrap, bounded receipt maintenance and fenced new-history disaster restore remain absent. The management parent record retains an earlier unlocalized transfer Overloaded refusal; the current source does not claim to fix it. A concurrent prototype read-suite replay also returned unlocalized VersionUnavailable in fallback_preserves_contract. Operation contexts were added without changing its assertions, deadlines, refusals or retry rules; passing serial qualification is not evidence that the concurrent refusal is fixed. No physical Amazon S3, power loss, independent physical failure zones, production performance/capacity, compatible-binary rollback, 24-hour soak, 30/100/1000-node tiers, federation or complete release is claimed. MR-13 remains IN_PROGRESS and MR-14 through MR-17 remain TODO. Vendored raft warnings remain visible.
